name: Fixed-Row Separation Formula
statement: For fixed normalized separator rows $A$, $\delta_A(c)=\min(1,\min_v N_c(v)/(1+P_c(v)))$ over probability vectors on the rows, and $\mu(C)=\max_A\min_c\delta_A(c)$. The fixed-row value is zero exactly when a convex combination of signed rows lies in the closed orthant of $c$.
proof: Convex separation converts feasibility of a box witness into all nonnegative weighted row inequalities. Coordinatewise minimization gives $tP_c(v)-N_c(v)$ and hence the ratio formula; compactness gives attainment.
